name: continue_agent
description: Continue a child role that has already finished, as a new instance seeded from its prior conversation. The new instance runs to completion and returns its ResultCard.

detailed: Continues a finished child role as a new instance seeded from its prior conversation.
friendly: Picks up a finished helper where it left off.
whimsical: Calls the specialist back for one more round.

detailed: tool {participantRole} is continuing a child role
whimsical: Picking up where they left off

role.description: Name of the finished child role to continue, as declared in the Guild.

roleId.description: Optional instance id of the finished child to continue when more than one instance of the role has finished.

comment.description: Optional message appended to the child's history to steer the continued work.
